overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures dehydrated Shikakai Powder sourced from selected Acacia concinna pods in India. As an FSSAI-registered supplier and IEC-registered exporter, we use a controlled six-step process comprising sourcing, cleaning, sorting, drying, grinding, and quality inspection. The resulting 100 mesh powder provides uniform consistency, low moisture under 8.0 percent, and dependable stability for industrial cosmetic applications.

Our dehydrated shikakai powder integrates seamlessly into modern cosmetic and personal care formulations. Designed for commercial product development, it serves as a functional ingredient for hair cleansers and masks. We supply bulk orders and private-label packaging with a minimum order quantity of 5 kg, complete with export documentation support and custom particle sizing on request.
highlights: Derived from dehydrated Acacia concinna pods
Processed through a dedicated six-step system

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for Shikakai Powder?
faqs.a: The minimum order quantity is 5 Kg, accommodating emerging brands and bulk industrial orders.

faqs.q: What is the standard mesh size and moisture specification?
faqs.a: Our standard Shikakai Powder is milled to 100 mesh with a moisture content kept below 8.0 percent.

faqs.q: Can TradeNest Naturals provide OEM and private labeling services?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer OEM and private label services, including custom packaging in retail pouches and jars.

faqs.q: What are the shelf life and storage conditions?
faqs.a: The powder has a shelf life of 24 months when stored in a cool, dry place away from sunlight and moisture.

faqs.q: Do you provide samples for testing and evaluation?
faqs.a: Yes, product samples are available on request to assist formulators prior to placing commercial orders.

faqs.q: What export support and documentation do you provide?
faqs.a: As an IEC-registered exporter, we offer complete export documentation support for international shipments.
